gemini.rationale: The slice provides no evidence of disruption at the product/process interface (p4_pathway) or the process/organization interface (p5_pathway). The acquired entity was integrated into a single operating segment, and there is no documented fracture or incoherence reported in the 3-5 year horizon.

grok.rationale: The slice documents only that DFT terminated separate SEC reporting shortly after closing and that Digital Realty's FY2020 10-K reports a single operating/reporting segment with no isolated DFT portfolio metrics or any integration narrative. No evidence of product/process misalignment or operations-versus-organization fracture appears in the traceable post-deal record, so both pathways code to absence-of-evidence (0). The same filings supply no realized-outcome scalar isolating the acquired business.

openai.rationale: The acquired entity terminated separate SEC reporting shortly after closing, and by FY2020 Digital Realty reported only one operating and reporting segment without isolating the former DFT portfolio’s performance [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-297819, Form 15-12B] [SRC: SEC accession 0001558370-21-002191, Form 10-K FY2020]. Consequently, the slice provides no traceable 3–5-year evidence sufficient to determine whether disruption occurred at either the product/process or process/organization interface.
